title: The Nail Hole Full of Sky
youtube_title: The Nail Hole Full of Sky | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Showing someone how to look is a kind of gift.
summary: At a meadow fence and a bucket of water, Violeta finds a nail hole in a fence full of blue. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Violeta shows Ciro how to look without disturbing it. Auntie Luz looks too, and they leave it where it is.
